selection: Pinned original selected project C/H/Makefile, embedded original XPM artwork, original saved files and selected README. Unused labs/docs and generated object/dependency files omitted.

files.reason: Keep authored notification bit IDs separate from returned Minix control handles, remove each actual subscription on teardown, check positive kernel errors, and update the menu cursor after each complete three-byte mouse packet. Use the authored timer notification bit in the match loop instead of casting a function address to a mask. Initialize vertical ball direction for a new match while preserving its existing valid direction on a scored-ball reset.
files.verification: Original actual subscriptions fail on legal handles10..13 and positive policy errors; corrected notify0/1/12/2 and saved cleanup handles pass. Actual menu loop originally waits for three complete packets before one cursor update; corrected one-complete-packet-to-one-update passes. Actual match owner receives W, sixty timer-bit0 notifications and Escape: original has zero ball/paddle updates and no second countdown; corrected has sixty ball updates, sixty held-paddle updates, time59 and exact three unsubscribes. Actual game_handler with patterned allocation originally exposes an undefined vert field. Corrected fresh-match owner sets vert0. The actual scored-ball reset preserves a valid up direction, retaining authored reset behavior.

files.reason: Read the KBC status register before each mouse command reply, consume exactly one ACK from the output register and bound the reply wait. Preserve original public stream-disable success1 convention.
files.verification: Original actual EA/F4/F5 owner reads output before delayed OBF and mistakes an ACK data bit for status. Independently delayed replies require two status polls before one0xFA read for each of the three commands; corrected exact six writes/three replies pass.

files.reason: Poll RTC update status before using it, returnNULL from pointer-returning I/O failure paths, restore interrupts and release allocated dates on failure, and release temporary dates after display.
files.verification: Original getDateOnly has twelve bare returns rejected by actual ARM64 objects and strict owning compile. Actual three date-reading functions under patterned storage check UIP before date fields, decode known BCD values, returnNULL/1 on I/O failure and restore interrupts; corrected test and all8 actual ARM64 build objects pass. Original CLI/STI instruction strings remain unchanged.

files.reason: Clip pixel writes at the actual1024x768 framebuffer edge; partially visible balls and paddles must not write outside the allocated buffer.
files.verification: Native ARM64 actual paint_ball+248 crash writes row768. Actual paint_ball/clear_ball under guarded buffers originally overwrite the bottom guard; corrected preserves both guards, clips right edge without row wrap, and draws visible fragments of negative-left coordinates.

controlsRationale: Original menu cursor0,0 and unit relative motion: move500,190 then separate Select to Play. Reserved panel exposes P1W/S and P2O/K as vertical pads. Escape ends the current match and displays original Winner/Draw for2seconds before returning to menu; collection Home exits. Original top-level main returns1 on normal menu exit; retained, no invented success conversion. Mobile relative mode avoids guessing source clamp/calibration.

artwork.icon: Simple SVG using original white paddles and square ball geometry on a dark tile. Rasterized to512x512PNG for the shared launcher contract; SVG source retained.
artwork.preview: Final corrected-source real gameplay canvas scaled640x480.

verification.browser: Actual normal touch500190+Select opens match. W raises left paddle, K lowers right paddle, ball/rally scoring advances0→2. Original RTC date/time rendered, portrait and landscape reserved controls inspected; no page errors.
verification.ndk: All8 actual ARM64 build objects passO2/FORTIFY2/stack-protector/format-security, including generated entry wrapper and unchanged source CLI/STI lowered by the reviewed shared compiler bridge.
verification.assembly: Original CLI/STI instruction strings remain unchanged.
verification.limitations: Menu Exit retains original status1. Escape ends match to Winner/Draw then returns menu after2s. No claim of every60second end or each RTC speed transition.

nativeGameplay.demonstrated: Current minimal v3b preserves original scored-ball direction. ROOT played a full timed native match with both paddles, natural scores, winner, menu and clean Home.
limitations: One full normal timed match and both players verified. UART-linked play and every competitive outcome are not claimed.
